conventions.K: set to 1 (quotient of U(A) by K-1)
conventions.ghat: g + C.1 = span of all quadratic oscillator monomials; g = [ghat,ghat]
conventions.vector_coordinates: dicts keyed by basis name; key '1' = scalar (unit) component

structure_constants.format: [Z_a, Z_b] = sum_k value * Z_k ; entries [a, b, k, value]

gamma.format: [Z_a,Z_b]_deformed = [Z_a,Z_b]_0 + kappa * sum_k (sum_gb value*gb) Z_k ; entries [a, b, k, gb_name, value]

explicit_f.definition: f_gb(Z) = kappa-coefficient of Phi(Z), Phi(a^s) = a^s + kappa*sum_j(-gb[s][j][-] b_j^+ + gb[s][j][+] b_j^-), Phi(b)=b
explicit_f.format: f(Z_j) = sum_i value*gb * Z_i ; entries [j, i, gb_name, value]

R3_scalar_part_conditions.explanation: under R3 one needs gamma_C(a,b) = 0 for all a,b; these are the linear forms (in gb) that must vanish
